finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 127 PRs. Only 15 items matter to users.

Three are breaking. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route is gone.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Ten fixes, including the latency histogram units, which shifts recorded values.

Two calls I made. I dated it `2026-08-30`. I left the perf work out, since your template allows only three headings.

Next: check the histogram wording and confirm the v1 route was truly public.
